x: Whilst talking of half miling we must congratulate Dave Cocks on setting up a new club Junior best of 1:56.4 - a performance which whilst it seemed inevitable, does erase from the book one of the most long-standing club records set up almost ten years ago by Frank Wright.

He bounced back for the road relays in scintillating form, winning our Club youth trial from County Champion Frank Wright and then recording third fastest time of the day in the popular Aylesbury Youth Relay.

Missing information: 800m F.Wright: HJ D.Williams 1.90 (81): LJ C.Brooks 7.06 (71) It is also believed that former Irish International Tony Brien posted marks from 2 Miles upwards that would make the top ten and efforts are being made to trace these performances.
